harness.pin.managedTip: the binary Daoris installed and runs sessions with. Daoris owns this location; the tool inside it is the tool's own.
harness.update.pinTip: Moves the pin to the newest release: finds its exact version, installs it where Daoris keeps it, and pins that. Nothing is fetched when the pin is already the newest.
harness.update.toolTip: Runs the tool's own updater, on the copy sessions run while nothing is pinned.
harness.profile.keyHint: Kept on this machine by Daoris, handed to the agent when a session starts, and shown back only as its last four characters.
harness.profile.removeConfirm: This deletes the account from this machine, sign-in included, and takes it out of Daoris's accounts. Starts that would have run on it run on the others.
harness.login.done: {{profile}} is signed in — sessions can run as it.
harness.login.failed: Sign-in did not finish (the tool exited {{code}}). Its output says why.
harness.loginNew.done: Signed in as {{account}} — sessions can run as it.
harness.loginNew.unnamed: Signed in — the tool did not say who, so the account is listed as {{profile}}.
harness.loginNew.nobody: Nobody was signed in, so nothing was kept.
harness.loginNew.failed: Sign-in did not finish (the tool exited {{code}}), so nothing was kept. Its output says why.
harness.login.keyedTip: The tool says signed in for any key, a wrong one included. A key is checked the first time a session uses it.
harness.login.refusedTip: Its provider refused this key when a session ran on it, so no start runs on it. Put a new API key into this account: it keeps its name and its place in the order.
harness.failed: {{harness}}: {{action}} exited {{code}}. The output above is the agent's own.
harness.settings.title: {{account}}: model and effort
harness.settings.modelIdPlaceholder: a model ID the agent accepts
harness.settings.perModel: Set per model — the tool reads these first, for that model:
harness.settings.hint: Kept in the tool's own settings file in this account's folder, and read by the tool when a session starts. A repository's own .claude/settings.json and the ANTHROPIC_MODEL variable take precedence over the model.
harness.settings.saved: {{account}}: saved — the next session reads it.
harness.settings.summary.own: the agent's own model and effort
harness.use.title: How accounts are used
harness.use.listLabel: Daoris's accounts, in the order they are used
harness.use.orderHint: `daoris agent profile order {{agent}} <account>…` puts the accounts named first, in that order.
harness.use.listWhy: Every account signed in for Daoris serves every workspace, in this order. One by one, in order begins at the first; Make the most of them uses the order only to break a tie. A conversation you start on an account is your own choice each time.
harness.use.mode.label: Use accounts
harness.use.mode.goalSays: Each start goes to the account running the fewest of Daoris's sessions, a week about to reset is spent first, and an account whose limit is reached, that draws on usage credits or whose use is over its curve is passed while another is ready.
harness.use.mode.orderSays: Every start runs on the first ready account in the order: one limit stops every session on that account.
harness.use.mode.why: Making the most of the accounts spreads what runs at once, so a limit cuts off fewer sessions, and spends each week's allowance before it lapses. One by one keeps your own accounts fresh and a quest's work on one account, at the cost that a limit stops everything running there.
harness.use.unsaid: No account has said what it has left yet. Daoris spreads starts across them by its own sessions, and learns each account's weekly reset from the limits it meets.
harness.use.keep.label: Keep for conversations
harness.use.keep.why: Driven work never starts on the kept account. Conversations and Ask Daoris reach it when the accounts before it are not ready, so it is the account left when driven work has spent the others.
harness.use.keep.needsTwo: Keeping an account for conversations needs another account for driven work.
harness.use.switch.label: Switch accounts
harness.use.switch.why: Per window, a curve says the most of it an account should have used at each moment of the window's time. A start passes an account whose limit is reached, that draws on usage credits, or whose use is over its curve, while another account is ready, and runs on it when none is. At the end of a turn, a session whose account is over its curve goes on with an account of the same agent at least ten points under its curve on every window, and does not move again within thirty minutes. Off, nothing moves a running session, and a start still passes an account over Daoris's curve and ranks the rest by their week's pace instead of their room under it.
harness.use.switch.smartSays: Daoris's curve: the five-hour window up to 90%, and the week its pace plus 20 points up to 95%, then rising evenly to 100% at its reset, so little of it lapses.
harness.use.switch.curveSays: Your own rows, a window each; a window you leave out takes Daoris's curve.
harness.use.switch.offSays: No switch while a session runs. A start still passes an account over Daoris's curve, and a limit still carries a session on.
harness.use.switch.silent: {{product}}'s sessions here do not say how much of each window is used, so a start passes no account by its use.
harness.curve.chart: The {{window}} window: its curve, and each account's use now
harness.curve.axes: Across, the share of the window's time gone; up, the share used.
harness.curve.clearHint: `daoris agent profile use {{agent}} --no-curve` — every window takes Daoris's curve again, and the switch stays as it is.
harness.use.problem.keep: The account kept for conversations, {{account}}, is not in the order, so nothing is kept. Keep one of the order, or none.
harness.use.problem.alone: The account kept for conversations, {{account}}, is the only one, so nothing is kept for driven work's sake. Add another account, or keep none.
harness.use.unknown: These accounts also set {{settings}}, which this build does not know; it is kept as written.
harness.cooling.why.assumed: the agent said so, in this machine's zone
harness.cooling.why.default: Daoris's default: the agent named no time
harness.cooling.why.notBelieved: Daoris's default: the agent named a date more than 8 days off
harness.cooling.ready: {{account}} is offered again. If its limit still holds, the agent refuses the next start at once, and it cools again.
harness.cooling.notCooling: {{account}} was not cooling, so nothing changed.
harness.said.reached: its {{window}} limit reached, by its own word
harness.said.warned: ahead of its pace on its {{window}} window, by its own word
harness.own.shared: Your own sign-in: the account this tool uses at your own terminal. It is not one of Daoris's accounts: Daoris never signs it in or out, never asks it anything, and starts no session in it, and adding an account never changes it. A conversation that began there before goes on there.
harness.terms: Each account's own plan and terms apply. Daoris runs only the accounts you hold and use here, for your own work, signed in through the tool's own sign-in, and claims nothing about how a maker's terms see several accounts.
